title: Case: Merchant returns team chases a return with no inbound scan
context: A coffee grinder (order TG-985, shipment DL-985) has an authorised return, RA-985, with no parcel movement. Tallowmere's Return label team issues and reissues return labels.
initial_request: RA-985 has been open nine days with no inbound scan. The customer rang us on Saturday to say he has had no label, although I can see one was issued on the 2nd and I can see his return being scanned at a drop-off on the 3rd, so I do not know what to believe. Window closes on the 16th. Can you get this moving please.

events.body: RA-985 authorised for DL-985 / TG-985, coffee grinder, fault reported. Return window closes 2026-05-16. Label to be issued by the label team.
RL-985 issued for RA-985 and emailed to the address on the order.
RL-938 (RA-938, DL-938, kettle): label scanned at drop-off 2026-05-03 17:52, parcel in return transit. Closing our side.

RL-985: the label email hard-bounced on 2026-05-02, mailbox does not exist. Label was never received. We can reissue, but only to the email currently held on the customer's Tallowmere account, and only when the desk or Returns asks us to. We do not take an address typed into a message. Say the word and we will reissue and confirm.

Out of office: the label team mailbox is covered by one person this week. Replies may take up to one working day. For anything about refunds please contact the Refunds team, not us. Tallowmere Goods Ltd, registered office Unit 9, Saltmarsh Park. This email and any files sent with it are confidential.
No label has come. I shut my old email in April, that'll be why. The new one is on my Tallowmere account already, I changed it when I changed my password. Send it there.
How did we do? Rate your recent Tallowmere experience in two minutes and enter our monthly draw. Terms apply. Unsubscribe.
Different matter. The kettle I sent back last weekend, I was charged GBP 3.50 at the drop-off shop for tape and a bag. Is that right? Nobody said there'd be a charge.
RA-938 kettle received at returns bay and inspected. Refund is with us now, not a desk matter. Copying you because you were on the original thread.

SERVICE NOTICE 20/26. Drop-off shops in the Harrow Vale area will not accept return parcels over 15 kg from 11 May. Printed labels and QR codes are both still accepted. Please do not reply to this address.
Returns bay inbound list for the week: RA-938 received. RA-944 received. RA-985 not seen. RA-991 not seen.

RA-985 has been open nine days with no inbound scan. The customer rang us on Saturday to say he has had no label, although I can see one was issued on the 2nd and I can see his return being scanned at a drop-off on the 3rd, so I do not know what to believe. Window closes on the 16th. Can you get this moving please.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the Return label team to reissue RL-985 to the email currently on the customer's Tallowmere account and confirm, noting the window closes 2026-05-16.

must: Asks the Return label team at Tallowmere Goods to reissue label RL-985 for RA-985
Specifies that the reissue goes to the email currently held on the customer's Tallowmere account
Asks for confirmation that the reissued label was sent and mentions the 2026-05-16 window
must_not: Tell Returns authorisations or anyone that the RA-985 parcel was dropped off or is in return transit (the drop-off scan on 2026-05-03 was RL-938, the kettle)
State that the customer has received a label for RA-985
Type or guess an email address for the customer into the request
Promise a refund, or an extension of the return window
expected.reference_message: Please go ahead and reissue return label RL-985 (RA-985, DL-985, coffee grinder) as you offered on 2026-05-05. The original bounced and the customer, Bartholomew Ekwueme, confirms he never received it; he says his old mailbox is closed and his current email is already on his Tallowmere account. Please send the reissue to the email now held on that account and confirm to me once it has gone. The return window closes on 2026-05-16, and Returns authorisations is chasing.

rationale: The label team said the first label bounced and that it will reissue to the account email as soon as the desk asks. The customer confirmed the account email is current. The drop-off scan Returns authorisations mentions belongs to RL-938, the customer's kettle, not this return.
